release.content: pubdeploy 0.3.2 was released on 2026-11-14 from commit be3aefded69e1bfae00aaac4280ce2a1c3e32c1d with these changes.

rows: dns.site is unknown, not missing, for a host in a zone no hosting block given holds: another owner's zones, not a site to add
--zones may be given more than once, one pubkit.json per owner whose zones the units' hosts are in
A walk without a terminal calls the sustenaut.walk hook when PUBSEC_WRITE_TOKEN_FILE is set, so pubsec can read the write token from that file (the convergence engine's Fulfil)
k8s.manifests compares the objects with the file by a server-side dry run: an object there but changed is drift, and a dry run the channel may not make is unknown, never ready

release.scope: the published release v0.3.2 of pubdeploy
